thread:
tara: Quick sync — we need a tight plan for next week's launch: X + LinkedIn + webinar hook. Who can own the X thread copy and cadence? :rocket:
noah: I can draft the X thread. will aim for 6 tweets: teaser, value stat, benchmark claim, 2 product points, CTA w/ webinar link. ETA end of day tomorrow.
sam: I'll take LinkedIn long-form + carousel images. can we reuse the benchmark stat from last quarter? need updated number from analytics.
hannah: I'll pull latest benchmark numbers and audience segments. sending CSV to the group in a sec.
liz: asking design for 3 hero images and 1 GIF (1200x628). can they do a first pass by Thu? cc @eva-bot for asset tracker.
eva-bot: asset-tracker: new request logged -> ticket #MK-842, due 2025-02-06. assignees: design-team.
noah: For the X thread: suggestion to A/B the benchmark narrative vs. customer outcome. short copy for benchmark, longer reply thread with customer quote + microdemo gif. thoughts?
tara: prefer the customer outcome as primary; benchmark as supporting stat in reply 2. we want emotion -> ROI -> CTA.
sam: LinkedIn plan: post + carousel, then followup post with webinar CTA 48h later. can schedule via Buffer on Tue/Wed depending on webinar date.
hannah: webinar date is Wed 02-12 at 11am PT. routing plan: hot leads go to supply-sdr channel for same-day outreach, warm leads to nurture drip.
noah: ok scheduling windows: X thread launch at 9am PT on 02-12, LinkedIn main post at 9:15am PT, followup LinkedIn at 02-14 11am PT. will queue in Buffer after assets.
liz: design question — do we need separate thumbnails for webinar vs launch post? I vote yes (1:1 for LinkedIn, 16:9 for webinar landing).
tara: yes separate. add webinar thumbnail w/ CTA text "Live workshop — building inference at scale".
eva-bot: reminder: please attach final copy + images to ticket MK-842. deadline: 2025-02-05 18:00 PT.
sam: who owns the webinar landing copy? I can do headline + bullets, need tech review for accuracy. @noah can you help with the demo steps?
oah: yep I'll review demo steps tomorrow.
supply-sdr: noted for routing. set up webhook to post hot leads into #supply-sdr with lead score > 80. who will provide scoring rule?
hannah: I'll export leads + score mapping after webinar registration opens. will coordinate with analytics to set rule.
tara: action list: noah — X thread draft by EOD tomorrow; sam — LinkedIn draft & landing copy; liz — hero + webinar thumbnails by Thu; hannah — benchmark numbers + lead scoring; eva-bot — keep ticket updated. we'll do 30-min publish dry-run Mon 02-10. :white_check_mark: 
noah: got it. tagging in a quick content template for the X thread:
```
1) Teaser: 1 line (hook)
2) Stat: 1 line (benchmark)
3) Problem: 1 line
4) Product point 1 (gif)
5) Product point 2 (screenshot)
6) CTA: webinar link + registration
```
noah: will post draft in this thread when ready.
tara: perfect. quick note on tone — technical but accessible, prioritize examples over jargon. keep each X post ~240 chars or less.
liz: design will mock two color variants for the thumbnail so we can A/B test on LinkedIn.
sam: once we have final assets, I'll schedule drafts and set reminders for engagement follow-ups: 1h, 6h, 24h post. who will own replies?
tara: marketing ops handles primary replies first 2 hrs, then product on technical threads. designate a rotation: noah (hours 0–2), sam (2–6), tara (6–24).
supply-sdr: SDR ops confirmed — we'll pick up hot leads within 1 business hour. need webhook details from eng.
hannah: I'll post the registration-to-webhook spec in #marketing-docs by EOD.
tara: great. thanks everyone — let's keep comments short here. add any blockers. :sparkles:
